 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Beginnig'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Beginning'.**
 
• The word '**beginning**' is a **noun** which means 'the point in time or space at which something starts'. **(आरंभ)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• The beginning of the movie was very exciting and engaging.
 
 
 
• **Therefore, the correct answer would be 'Beginnig'.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Interrupt -** stop the continuous progress of (an activity or process) **(बाधित करना)**
 
• **Occurrence - **an incident or event **(घटना)**
 
• **Cemetery -** a large burial ground, especially one not in a churchyard **(कब्रिस्तान)**
